elements.name: Sagittarius
elements.text: Sagittarius: the pull of exploration and optimism, valuing the journey itself over any fixed destination.

elements.name: Starry sash
elements.text: The starry sash flowing between her hands: the alchemy of Temperance, blending separate elements into something greater than their sum.

elements.name: Cup
elements.text: The cup tipped between her fingers: patient testing and mixing, tempering experience before it's swallowed whole.
